text:
A dog found a big piece of meat. He was very happy. He took it in his mouth and ran home.

On the way, he crossed a small bridge over a river. He looked down at the water. He saw another dog! That dog also had a big piece of meat.

“His meat looks bigger than mine,” thought the dog. “I want it!”

He opened his mouth and barked loudly at the other dog. But when he opened his mouth, his meat fell into the river. Splash!

The dog looked into the water. The other dog was gone. The meat was gone, too.

He understood. The other dog was only his reflection. There was no second piece of meat.

The dog went home hungry and sad. “I wanted more,” he said, “and I lost everything.”

Moral: Be happy with what you have. If you want too much, you may lose it all.

quiz.q: The dog crossed a small bridge over a river.
There really was a second dog in the water.
What did the dog see in the water?
Why did the dog lose his meat?
o: He opened his mouth to bark
